cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: broad selling, 9% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -3.70% · WTI +0.93% · Brent +0.64% · NatGas +4.38%. At the last close, 9% of 67 energy names were green — broad selling. Oil & Gas Majors did the heavy lifting at +0.20%.

cards.headline: Oil & Gas Majors leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Oil & Gas Majors at +0.20%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -7.47%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at -15.30%
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
